From 2a4417bb8ef154a3ea17ab69f1e6bf695d5df41d Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Aksel Skauge Mellbye <aksel.mellbye@silabs.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Jun 2024 20:01:24 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] soc: silabs: Fix CMake test for soc family

Kconfig options need CONFIG_ prefix when tested for in CMakeLists.txt.

Fixes regression introduced in e90c89d45311aed6612113cf6bfdce652bba250d
that causes all apps to fail to initialize on Silabs socs.

Signed-off-by: Aksel Skauge Mellbye <aksel.mellbye@silabs.com>

diff --git a/soc/silabs/common/CMakeLists.txt b/soc/silabs/common/CMakeLists.txt
index a3e08c2fce1..7d1ed736667 100644
--- a/soc/silabs/common/CMakeLists.txt
+++ b/soc/silabs/common/CMakeLists.txt
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 # SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 
-if(SOC_FAMILY_SILABS_S0 OR SOC_FAMILY_SILABS_S1 OR SOC_FAMILY_SILABS_S2)
+if(CONFIG_SOC_FAMILY_SILABS_S0 OR CONFIG_SOC_FAMILY_SILABS_S1 OR CONFIG_SOC_FAMILY_SILABS_S2)
   zephyr_sources(soc.c)
 endif()
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `soc/silabs/common/CMakeLists.txt`**
   - The condition checking for the SOC family has been modified. The original condition:
     ```cmake
     if(SOC_FAMILY_SILABS_S0 OR SOC_FAMILY_SILABS_S1 OR SOC_FAMILY_SILABS_S2)
     ```
     has been changed to:
     ```cmake
     if(CONFIG_SOC_FAMILY_SILABS_S0 OR CONFIG_SOC_FAMILY_SILABS_S1 OR CONFIG_SOC_FAMILY_SILABS_S2)
     ```
   - This change adds the `CONFIG_` prefix to the Kconfig options being tested.

### Relationships

- The modification in `CMakeLists.txt` addresses a regression issue introduced in a previous commit (e90c89d45311aed6612113cf6bfdce652bba250d) that caused applications to fail to initialize on Silabs SoCs. By correcting the condition to include the `CONFIG_` prefix, the patch ensures that the CMake configuration correctly recognizes the Kconfig options, thereby restoring the expected functionality for applications targeting Silabs SoCs.

soc: silabs: Fix CMake test for soc family

Kconfig options need CONFIG_ prefix when tested for in CMakeLists.txt.

Fixes regression introduced in e90c89d45311aed6612113cf6bfdce652bba250d
that causes all apps to fail to initialize on Silabs socs.

Signed-off-by: Aksel Skauge Mellbye <aksel.mellbye@silabs.com>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the omission of the `CONFIG_` prefix in the condition checks within the CMakeLists.txt file, which led to the failure of the build system to correctly identify the Kconfig options for the Silabs SoCs, resulting in all applications failing to initialize.

+if(CONFIG_SOC_FAMILY_SILABS_S0 OR CONFIG_SOC_FAMILY_SILABS_S1 OR CONFIG_SOC_FAMILY_SILABS_S2)
   zephyr_sources(soc.c)
 endif()

Reason:
The absence of the `CONFIG_` prefix in the condition checks prevents the CMake build system from correctly identifying the Kconfig options for the Silabs SoCs, leading to a failure in initializing all applications.
